**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

The IP and data ownership provisions sit at our **preferred** position:

- **§14.1 / §15.1** — Customer owns all Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information, Customer-provided material and independently developed IP; Vendor gets only a limited processing right to deliver the Services, with express bars on sale, advertising use, data commingling and model training.
- **§14.2** — Deliverables vest in Customer on creation (subject to payment), with an express Vendor assignment, flow-down assignments from Vendor personnel, and further-assurance cooperation.
- **§14.3 + §13.2** — Vendor keeps only its pre-existing Vendor Technology, and any Vendor Technology embedded in a Deliverable carries a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, modify, create derivative works and have contractors support it — with a duty to flag material Vendor Technology before delivery.
- **§14.4** — No joint ownership absent a signed instrument specifying exploitation rights; feedback is voluntary and we retain unrestricted rights in our own feedback.

No provision elsewhere in the Agreement assigns our IP or data to Brightline, so no changes are needed.
